findings.title: rubric.json fingerprint test_case sha256_hex is a placeholder instruction string, not an actual hash
findings.detail: rubric.json test_case sha256_hex was 'verify-with-echo-n-concat-sha256sum' — a shell instruction, not a verifiable hash. The actual SHA-256 of the concat string 'logic|src/queue/store.ts|jsonparse without error handling on database content' is 0fbc4d44bf190b06b63015d48d6edee394613c022fa71162551afc6e63542bf7. Any implementation validating against the test_case would always fail, making the test_case useless.
findings.fix_sketch: Replace sha256_hex placeholder with the actual hex digest. Verified with: echo -n 'logic|src/queue/store.ts|jsonparse without error handling on database content' | sha256sum

findings.title: rubric.json categories dict does not include 'cosmetic', but scan files emit findings with category:'cosmetic'
findings.detail: rubric.json categories lists: logic, assumption, overconfidence, risk, redo — no 'cosmetic'. Three scan files (2026-05-24T04:21:11Z.json, 20260531T042437Z.json) contain findings with category:'cosmetic'. Since category is a fingerprint input, undocumented category values produce fingerprints that can't be normalized by rubric-defined rules, breaking regression detection for those findings.

findings.title: ADR-005 in ifleet-integration-adrs.md references phantom file 'ifleet_elevation_plan.md'
findings.detail: ADR-005 open questions cite 'ifleet_elevation_plan.md' as the source for the #ifleet-proposals channel name and the M5 budget-gate spec. This file does not exist. The actual plan lives in plan.md in this repo. Same class of error as the previously-fixed 'eventual-growing-raven.md' phantom reference in ADR-003.

findings.title: README.md splittasks link is a placeholder (https://github.com/...)
findings.detail: README.md line 3 has '[splittasks](https://github.com/...)' — a placeholder URL never filled in. Splittasks is local internal infrastructure with no public repo URL.
findings.fix_sketch: Replace broken placeholder link with prose describing the local infrastructure path: ~/.claude/skills/splittasks/SKILL.md.

findings.title: lane-scheduler-spec.md has hard-coded /Users/Seb absolute paths in two places
findings.detail: lane-scheduler-spec.md line 26 uses '/Users/Seb/.omc/splits/<id>/' and line 116 uses '/Users/Seb/.claude/scripts/lane-scheduler.pm2.json'. The rest of the codebase uses tilde notation. Absolute paths break on any machine other than Sebastian's Mac.

findings.title: self-heal-pipeline.md synthetic proof path uses absolute /Users/Seb reference
findings.detail: self-heal-pipeline.md line 326 references the synthetic proof at '/Users/Seb/.omc/splits/20260520-2244-elevation-push/T3-synthetic-proof.md' using an absolute path. The 2026-05-31 audit fixed README.md but missed this file.
